gaps: The posture is still upright: the forearms now hang 12 degrees forward, but the sheet hunches the torso and drives the fists ahead of the knees. The spine hunch was not built (a pelvis pitch drops the belt front into the planted thigh plate in frozen).

The upper-body brass is darker than the sheet's in the engine (shoulder plates V 0.43 to 0.46 and head V 0.44 against about 0.60) while the forearm matches (V 0.49 to 0.52). Brass is one slot with one tint, so lifting it means raising the manifest tint together with the asset-check materials record.
The walnut has plank joints and five shades but no fine wood grain (that needs a baked texture with real UVs); the pleats are close in hue (20 against 15) but less saturated (S 0.41 against 0.47).
From the side the upper arm leaves through the centre of the shoulder plate's lens, so the dark lens reads as a ring round the arm rather than a full disc.
The curled finger tips read slightly pointed where each sweep turns under the mass.
The feet are layered blocks and the pelvis is a plain gunmetal bulge.

Through the death fall the thigh plates pass under the belt band while the body folds (about 30 crossing triangles per side), and for about 0.1 s mid-fall (frames 34 to 37) the inner rim of each shoulder plate crosses the back of the chimney base (20 to 23 triangles outside the barrel, up to 1.3 cm deep).
The grille glow hue (41 against the sheet's 33), its orange-red rim and spill, and the hit flare belong to the shared runtime glow, pending an owner decision.
In the EEVEE compare renders the grilles read pale because the D11 glow ramp is runtime-only; the engine shots show the intended amber core.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score from bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg: orthographic EEVEE renders (AgX, the fixed shared light rig, not tuned to the score) of the low-poly model at the concept sheet's front, side and back angles, framed at the sheet's own scale (2.1 m over 806 sheet pixels), judged side by side against the sheet crops, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine (three.js 0.186.1, headless Chromium on ANGLE Metal, Apple M4, with the runtime D11 glow look; glow-close is the seat camera narrowed to the upper body). This pass followed the independent review (77/100) and its top fixes: the drum pauldrons are replaced by one tall shoulder plate per side (front: x 0.47 to 0.72, z 1.18 to 1.82, a sloped top and rounded outer corner; side: a rim ring, a mid ring and a bezel round a dark glass lens; still a surface of revolution about the shoulder axis, so it turns in place through the attack raise) with a front-outer emerald; each fist is a rounded mitt (p 3 loft, 0.53 m wide) with four round curled finger sweeps whose fronts face the room and a rounded thumb folded across them; the barrel is an egg (widest 0.60 at z 1.47 to 1.52, 0.556 at the bottom band) over rounder pleats; the forearms hang 12 degrees forward; each walnut stave is five planks with 8 mm joints onto the dark interior in five hashed shades (case roughness 0.92); the face plate stands 1.6 cm proud with round 16-segment eyes; the elbow emeralds sit on the forearm cuffs' front-outer face. A green blob count (hue 100 to 170, S > 0.4, at least 4 px) on the front compare panel finds 6 emeralds (2 shoulder, 2 elbow, 2 knee). Engine colour medians (idle shot unless noted): forearm brass (133, 100, 58) and (124, 91, 49), V 0.52 and 0.49; head (111, 79, 38), V 0.44; shoulder plates (117, 87, 45) and (110, 81, 43) in glow-close, V 0.46 and 0.43 (concept about V 0.61); finger fronts V 0.53 on the upper fronts and 0.36 on the lower curl (the pass-3 plate fronts measured 0.28 in the same box); barrel walnut (69, 50, 32), V 0.27 under the walnut mask and (52, 37, 30), V 0.20 on the stave field right of the grille in glow-close (concept about V 0.22); pleats between the straps (51, 37, 30), hue 20, S 0.41, V 0.20 (concept hue 15, S 0.47, V 0.17); front grille glow (245, 192, 80); eyes (243, 178, 71). Fine high-pass std (gray minus a 3 px blur) on the stave field rose from 1.41 to 2.20 (right of the grille) and from 6.03 to 8.78 (above the grille) against pass 3 in the same boxes. Vent: the chimney flame plume on the sheet is not modeled. p5-automatons-design.md models the vent as an emissive chimney mouth only and the art bible rules out smoke, so each mouth carries a glowing ember dome instead; this is a design-note deviation, not a fidelity gap.

rubric.note: Up 1 from 23, from model changes. The drum-stack pauldrons are gone: the shoulders are now tall rounded plates running from the barrel top down to the strap belt, with concentric rings and an emerald on the outer face (side compare panel, three-quarter render). In front and back they still read as bulbous pillow capsules standing beside the barrel (2x crop of the front compare panel, glow-close x 640-960, y 180-560), not the sheet's curved plates that hug the barrel and flare outward at the top. The overall front envelope is close. Non-background row spans (more than 30 summed RGB from the backdrop) on the front compare panels are 100/170/191/211/257/263/257/272 px for the model against 112/169/193/213/249/263/280/284 px for the concept at 15-90% of figure height, with the same 1.11 width-to-height ratio. The side is not close: the model's side spans are 204/207/203 px at 15/25/35% of height against the concept's 149/172/208 px, so the model is widest at the top with near-vertical sides, where the sheet's egg swells at mid-chest and tapers upward. The front barrel also keeps straight sides and square upper corners. The fists are now rounded mitts in the back and three-quarter views. Unchanged from the 77: the upright posture with the forearm hanging under the shoulder (side panel), where the sheet hunches and drives the fist ahead of the knee, and flat stacked-slab feet (front compare 2x crop, bottom 60 px).

Up 1 from 21, from model changes. Six grille slots confirmed as six glow runs on rows y 400, 420 and 440 of glow-close (mask R>235, G>150, B<120), inner slot widths 21-23 px. Emeralds now sit at the sheet's front positions: green blobs (hue 100-170, S>0.4, at least 4 px) on the model front compare panel are at both shoulder plates (386, 471) and (552, 471), the left gauntlet top (345, 524) and both knees (432, 603) and (506, 603), with the right gauntlet gem visible at 2x below the threshold. The concept front panel's blobs are both shoulders (the right one split in two), and both elbows; its knee gems fall below the threshold but are visible by eye, so the positions match at six. The side ring and emerald now exist, but the dark lens is the gunmetal upper arm itself: at compare x 1040-1110, y 390-480 (4x) the concentric brass rings frame the arm, which fills the centre, so there is no separate lens disc. The fists now have four curled tubular fingers with a thumb folded across (idle crop x 0-360, y 420-720 at 2x), replacing the pass-3 flat plates. Still off: the finger ends are pointed chevrons rather than the sheet's blunt rounded knuckles (same crop and frozen x 480-960, y 560-720), and the thumb is a plain cylinder rod. The head has round eyes and a raised face-plate rectangle, but the raise is a thin edge (glow-close x 260-700, y 0-330 at 2x), not the sheet's distinct visor. Ember domes replace the flame plume per the design note.

Up 1 from 13, from model changes. The walnut now carries plank joints: dark horizontal seams about 70 px apart and vertical stave seams at glow-close (grid crop x 440-760, y 100-400). There is still no wood grain. A high-pass std (grayscale minus a 3 px Gaussian blur) inside a clean plank box (525-575, 225-275) is 0.38, against 5.0 in a clean stave box on the sheet (660-700, 300-340 original px). A box that includes a seam (530-580, 300-380) measures 2.99, so the seams are the only texture. The brass is clean and smooth, and the curled fingers are well shaded with none of the pass-3 slot-like dark fronts. One small geometry flaw: the inner bottom corner of each shoulder plate ends in a sharp triangular facet wedge against the barrel (idle x 620-632, y 287-305 and glow-close x 600-620, y 525-545, both at 4x). It is a static notch, not z-fighting. Posed frames (attack, hit, frozen, anim-attack-raise, rig-rom-reach) show the plates following the upper arm with no visible intersection with the barrel or chimneys, and the pale patch in frozen is the fist's brass highlight, not a hole. The face plate stays a thin outline, the pelvis is a dark gunmetal band with a small brass wedge (compare x 420-520, y 540-600 at 4x) where the sheet has a broad brass hip plate, and the feet are stacked blocks.

Up 1 from 12, from a model change: the shoulder-plate brass. Idle box (630-680, 150-250) median (154, 119, 72), hue 34, S 0.53, V 0.60, against the sheet's shoulder plate (168, 127, 69), hue 35, V 0.66; pass 3 was V 0.45. Head brass (172, 125, 64), V 0.68. Walnut on matched lit sides: the model's lit-side box (315-340, 140-200) is (94, 67, 49), hue 24, S 0.48, V 0.37, against the sheet's masked barrel walnut (84, 52, 35), hue 21, S 0.58, V 0.33, so value and hue are close and saturation is lower. The model's shadow side (565-615, 150-210) is (53, 39, 31), V 0.21. The pleats (375-525, 325-400) also median (53, 39, 31), hue 22, S 0.42, against the sheet's (59, 34, 22), hue 19, S 0.63. The pleats moved closer to the sheet's hue since the 77 (hue 29 then), but they now render the same colour as shadowed walnut, so pleats and barrel no longer separate by colour the way the sheet's redder, more saturated pleats do. Excluded as pending the owner glow decision: the grille glow is (247, 200, 81), hue 43, against the sheet's (246, 154, 48), hue 32. The 77 counted that hue gap here.

Up 1 from 8. The model change: at 2.6 m in idle, attack, hit and frozen the fists now read as clenched fists with curled fingers instead of boxes with four dark slots, and the brighter shoulder plates hold the upper silhouette against the dark backdrop. The head, two eyes and six-slot grille remain the focal point. The 77 also deducted for the missing hit flare, which is now excluded as pending the owner glow decision: the hit glow (243, 202, 86) still matches idle (247, 200, 81). If the flare were still counted this criterion would stay at 8 and the total would be 81.

topFixes: Reshape the shoulder plates from bulbous capsules into the sheet's curved shells: thin each plate toward the barrel, let its inner edge wrap over the barrel's upper curve, and flare the top outward so it rises above the barrel shoulder in the front and back views. Remove the triangular wedge at each plate's inner bottom corner. Keep the side rings and emerald, and add a dark lens disc the arm attaches behind.

Give the barrel the sheet's egg. In side view narrow the upper third (the model measures 204-207 px against the concept's 149-172 px at 15-25% of figure height) so it swells widest at mid-chest, and round the front upper corners so the front sides curve instead of standing vertical.
Add the forward hunch: pitch the torso forward about 10-15 degrees and angle the forearms so the fists sit ahead of the knees in the idle and side views.

Add wood grain to the walnut through a baked or tileable normal and albedo variation (target a high-pass std of about 4-5 against 0.4 now), raise walnut saturation from S 0.48 to about 0.58, and push the pleats redder and more saturated (hue 19, S about 0.6) so they separate from the barrel.

Blunt the curled finger tips into rounded knuckles, replace the cylinder-rod thumb with a shaped plated thumb, replace the slab feet with the sheet's rounded layered boots, and widen the pelvis wedge into the sheet's brass hip plate.
Pending the owner glow decision: shift the grille glow from hue 43 to about 32 with an orange-red rim and a spill onto the walnut, and add a brief core flare to the hit clip.
independentScore.method: Independent pass-4 review by an agent that did not build the model. The author header text and self-score on the compare sheet were ignored, and only provenance.json independentScore (77) was read, for deltas. Silhouette came from the orthographic front, side and back panels of bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg, cropped and enlarged 2-4x with Pillow beside the concept panels, plus non-background row-span scans at 15-90% of figure height and the Blender three-quarter render. Material, colour and readability came from the six three.js engine shots, with 2-4x Lanczos crops and coordinate grids of the idle fist and torso and of the glow-close head, shoulder plate and walnut. Posed frames (attack, hit, frozen, anim-attack-raise, rig-rom-reach) were cropped at the shoulder plates to check for new intersections. Colours are medians over hand-placed boxes with hue, saturation and value masks (walnut hue 5-32 at V<0.40, brass hue 22-50 at V>0.35, pleats V<0.30, glow max channel above 180), compared with matched lit-side boxes on golem-sheet-1.png measured this pass. Grain is a high-pass standard deviation (grayscale minus a Gaussian blur). Grille slots are glow runs along rows of glow-close, and emeralds are green connected blobs in the compare panels. Results on the pass-4 claims: curved shoulder plates with ring, lens and emerald are partly met (rings and emerald yes, no separate lens, front and back shape still a capsule); rounded mitt fists with curled fingers are met, with pointed tips; the egg barrel is not met in front or side; darker walnut with plank joints is met for joints and the shadow side, with no grain; raised face plate and round eyes are met for the eyes, with the plate only a thin edge; six front emeralds are met. Glow hue and the hit flare were excluded as pending the owner decision, and the readability note states the one point that exclusion is worth. The rubric weights are 30, 25, 20, 15 and 10, the bar is 80, and the points sum to the score.
